# Female High-Pitched Scream SFX

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/female-high-pitched-scream-sfx

Downloaded source file:

- `screams.ogg`

License: CC0.

Usage in Blackout Hunt:

- `Tools/GenerateAudioSources.ps1` processes a short segment into `Content/BlackoutHunt/Audio/Sources/BH_TerrifiedScream_Faint.wav`
- the processed scream is mixed faintly into `BH_EerieLobbyLoop.wav`
- the processed scream is also imported as `/Game/BlackoutHunt/Audio/SW_TerrifiedScreamFaint`
